text: さっき　きいたことは　わすれろよ！

structure.jp: さっき　きいたことは

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: さっき　きいたこと
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. こと here is 'thing'. さっき　きいたこと = 'the thing you heard just now'.

patterns.name: 〜ろ (command)
patterns.explanation: This verb ending is a blunt order, rude unless said to a friend. わすれる becomes わすれろ. わすれろよ = 'forget it, got that!'
